problem: Calculate the circulation $Γ$ of the vector field $F(x,y)=\frac{1}{y}\,i-\frac{1}{x}\,j$ along the closed curve $C$ given by $r(t)=\operatorname{cos}⁡t\,i+\operatorname{sin}⁡t\,j$ for $t\in [0,2\pi ).$ Interpret circulation as the sum of four convergent improper line integrals over the open quadrant arcs, with independent one-sided limits at $(\pm1,0)$ and $(0,\pm1)$. The field is undefined at those four points, so the original ordinary circulation is not defined.
